formula.formula: Public index: 100*(0.2585*category[knowledge] + 0.2585*category[language] + 0.2002*category[retrieval] + 0.1828*category[tools] + 0.1000*category[arts]). Full score: 0.20*public + 0.50*private_same_skills + 0.30*private_new_domains, private parts mapped onto the public scale with untuned stock models

clarifications: CRUXEval uses the sole frozen output-choice track; the proposal incorrectly mentioned an input track that does not exist in this suite.
Interactive scores use existing frozen pilots and first complete benchmark runs, not the proposed expanded three-repeat protocol.
Reproductions have no interactive runs. Those six benchmarks receive zero only as labeled provisional lower bounds, never an official final ranking.
Unsupported source cases receive zero before chance normalization. F1 uses fixed label universes and conservative missing-label penalties.
All linked requests must succeed for source-case support; no successful-intersection score shortcut.
Point estimates only; paired cluster-bootstrap uncertainty is not yet calculated.
The index panel is the Decision Index 0.3 panel (decision-index-0.3), not the frozen core25 proposal; core25 scores are still computed and kept as frozen_scores.

Benchmarks outside the frozen core25 panel enter with their board score times the answered share (unanswered or unsupported counts as wrong); the 19 core25 static benchmarks keep their case-group coverage adjustment.
